findings.title: Proceeds from Disposals has no plan data
findings.detail: Referenced by Cash Flow from Investing Activities but evaluates to 0 in every version.
findings.prompt: Proceeds from Disposals (cf-disposals) has no data. Should it stay in the Cash Flow from Investing Activities formula, and how should it be planned (driver, % of another line, or ML forecast)?

findings.title: Add Cost of Goods Sold % of Net Sales
findings.detail: Cost of Goods Sold has no ratio KPI — common in EPM reporting packs.
findings.prompt: Add a new KPI "Cost of Goods Sold % of Net Sales" = cogs / rev * 100.

findings.prompt: Add a new KPI "Operating Expenses % of Net Sales" = opex-excl / rev * 100.

findings.title: Gross Sales (Stores, Web Shops & Club/Team B2B) moved NOK -134M vs Budget
findings.detail: Largest Q3 Forecast vs Budget movement among P&L inputs.
findings.prompt: Explain the NOK -134M movement in Gross Sales (Stores, Web Shops & Club/Team B2B) between Budget and Q3 Forecast and its impact through to EBITDA and Net Income.
